description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveDao class, which manages data access operations related to employees' leave information in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving lists of employees on leave and counting such employees, utilizing Doctrine ORM query building with filters and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for retrieving employee leave data in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees on leave based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object configured with filters for leave records, including status and date constraints.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees on leave matching the specified filter parameters.
